target_customer: Companies and developers with manual or brittle browser-based workflows such as procurement, invoice download, insurance quotes and legacy portal data entry
problem: Browser automation with scripts breaks whenever a site changes. Skyvern uses LLMs and computer vision so agents can operate unseen websites without per-site selectors.
business_model: Open source (AGPL) core plus paid managed cloud, usage-based API and enterprise plans

founders.name: Suchintan Singh
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built ML platforms at Faire and Gopuff. Education not listed.

founders.name: Shuchang Zheng
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built testing tools at Lyft and helped scale payments and database infrastructure at Patreon. Education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: In mid 2023 reliably driving arbitrary websites with vision language models, handling logins, CAPTCHAs and dynamic pages, was research adjacent and needed constant model tuning for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code and fast moving model capabilities make copying easy. Workflow integrations and hosted infrastructure give modest lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model labs later shipped computer use and browser agents, and many open source rivals appeared. No incumbent acquired Skyvern in the sources found.

market_need_then: RPA and scraping scripts were known to be brittle and costly to maintain, and LLM tool use arrived in 2023, creating a chance to replace per-site scripts. Demand evidence in the sources is the company's own claimed usage numbers.

branding.domain_note: Uses skyvern.com; no purchase history found.

identity.visual_style: Developer tool marketing site with product demos
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, comparison and changelog style blog content

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo claimed on the site at about 23,400 GitHub stars; Product Hunt launches with community votes per aggregators.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand itself. Strength comes from the open source repo and developer community rather than the name or identity.

outcome_analysis: Skyvern rode the 2023 shift to LLM agents with an open source browser automation tool and by December 2025 announced a 2.7 million dollar seed round, while claiming large GitHub and customer numbers. Raising only a seed more than two years after the batch and facing model lab entrants and many open source rivals suggest a still contested position. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found.
notes: Seed amount comes from the company blog dated 2025-12-18, which names no investors. An aggregator lists Y Combinator and Sunstone Management as investors, unverified. CB Insights shows 730K total and VCBacked 500K in 2023 pre-seed, both unverified and likely the YC deal. Competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 comparison pages, nothing dated near the 2023 batch, so competitors are left empty. Name origin and logo not found.
